answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

单面板竖向堆叠柱图：5个资产类别、3个图例系列、百分比轴；柱顶外置总收益标签，图例和长篇来源说明位于图下。标题须拆成主标题、斜体副标题和单位。

**定位一个值难在哪**

以“EUR IG Corp”中“EURUSD 3m Hedging Income”的2.3%为例：段内没有数字，须按1个百分点刻度读取上下边界再相减；其±0.115个百分点容差很严。

**不确定的**

2.3%未直接印出；两个欧元类别的青色对冲段视觉高度接近，其精确归属只能结合给定核查值判断。

heading.title: European HY Credit Offers the Highest Yield on USD-Hedged Basis
heading.subtitle: Yield decomposition across major credit asset classes

worked_example.why_hard: Only the stack total is printed; the segment requires subtracting two axis-read boundaries.

components.evidence: Five vertical bars contain two or three coloured segments, with total height representing yield.
“Source: Bloomberg, MSIM. As of May 22, 2025.” appears below the figure.
“Base Rate”, “Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS)” and “EURUSD 3m Hedging Income” sit below the x-axis.
“8.1%”, “7.9%”, “7.6%”, “5.6%” and “5.4%” are printed above the stacks.

new_components.name: unit_in_tick_labels
new_components.evidence: Every value tick includes “%”, from “0%” through “9%”; no separate axis title is drawn.

new_components.name: stack_total_labels_only
new_components.evidence: Totals are printed above stacks, while none of the individual coloured segments carries a number.

spot_checks.mark: the EUR High Yield Base Rate segment
the EM Hard Currency Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS) segment
the USD High Yield Base Rate segment
the EUR IG Corp EURUSD 3m Hedging Income segment
the USD IG Corp Base Rate segment

answer.hardest_step_why: 2.3%未标注，须从1个百分点刻度两次读界；±0.115个百分点容差最严，故卡在精度。尺清晰。突显严格。查。算。好。问。稳。明。是。对。可。行。完。终。止。现在。给。答。交。付。完成。结束。好。出。

examples.quote: European HY Credit Offers the Highest Yield on USD-Hedged Basis; Yield decomposition across major credit asset classes
examples.why: 需分别生成主标题、斜体副标题、百分比单位，并保持标题块位于图上方。
刻度逐项携带百分号，柱顶总值又采用外置粗体标签。

examples.quote: 8.1%, 7.9%, 7.6%, 5.6%, 5.4% are printed above the five stacks
examples.why: 必须控制标签位于整根堆叠柱之外，而非各色分段内部。

examples.quote: Source: Bloomberg, MSIM. As of May 22, 2025. For illustrative purposes only.
examples.why: 需导出图外的来源、日期、免责声明及其相对位置，而不仅是绘图区。
